description: How many new job ads an employer posted each month over the last 10 months (all fields, or one field), with the growth of the last three months against the three before when the counts support it, and the month of its first ad. The same monthly counts as the hiring chart on the employer's JobCrawls company page. Takes a companyId from a search result. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

companyId.description: The companyId from a search result or a company card. Not a display name.

field.description: A field of work as it appears in the data, e.g. "Software Engineering". Omit for all fields.

name: get_company_hiring

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.

title: Company hiring history
